mapper.insert: INSERT INTO basic_condition (campus_list, bed_count, inpatient_count, avg_daily_outpatient_count, disease_source, create_by, keshi) VALUES (#{dto.campusList}, #{dto.bedCount}, #{dto.inpatientCount}, #{dto.avgDailyOutpatientCount}, #{dto.diseaseSource}, #{dto.createBy}, #{dto.keshi})
mapper.select: SELECT id, create_by AS createBy, campus_list AS campusList, bed_count AS bedCount, inpatient_count AS inpatientCount, avg_daily_outpatient_count AS avgDailyOutpatientCount, disease_source AS diseaseSource FROM basic_condition WHERE create_by = #{createBy} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM basic_condition WHERE keshi = #{keshi} ORDER BY create_time DESC
